topic: Decide which streaming service the flat share keeps when cutting costs

scenario.topic: Decide which streaming service the flat share keeps when cutting costs
scenario.opening_question: Which streaming service should we keep to balance cost, content, and user experience?

options.name: Netflix Standard Plan with HD Streaming
options.upside: Largest content library with popular originals and good HD quality.
options.tradeoff: Slightly higher cost and only 2 simultaneous streams may limit simultaneous viewing.
options.concern: May not support all three users watching different shows at the same time.
options.best_for: users valuing content variety and video quality over maximum simultaneous streams.

options.name: Disney+ Basic Plan with Ads
options.upside: Lowest cost with 4 simultaneous streams, great for families and franchise fans.
options.tradeoff: Includes ads which may interrupt viewing experience.
options.concern: Limited content variety outside Disney-owned franchises and ads may annoy some users.
options.best_for: budget-conscious users who watch mostly family-friendly or franchise content.

options.name: Amazon Prime Video Included with Prime
options.upside: Good all-around content plus additional Prime benefits like free shipping.
options.tradeoff: Content library is smaller and less focused on originals compared to competitors.
options.concern: Some popular shows require extra rental fees, complicating cost predictability.
options.best_for: users who want a mix of streaming and other Amazon Prime perks.

options.name: HBO Max Ad-Free Plan
options.upside: High-quality original series and movies with no ads.
options.tradeoff: Higher cost with fewer simultaneous streams than some cheaper options.
options.concern: Smaller library size and fewer family-friendly options might not suit everyone.
options.best_for: users prioritizing premium content and ad-free experience.

shared_context: The flat share has exactly 3 people.
The monthly budget for streaming services must not exceed $20.
The goal is to cut costs while keeping the service that best fits everyone's viewing habits.

personas.name: Yuki
personas.background: Yuki is budget-conscious and prefers family-friendly content with multiple simultaneous streams to accommodate flatmates' varied schedules.
personas.private_goal: To keep the most affordable streaming service that allows everyone to watch different shows at the same time.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
object to the main rival option with a concrete concern

personas.name: Olga
personas.background: Olga values premium, ad-free content and high-quality original series, prioritizing a better viewing experience over cost.
personas.private_goal: To maintain access to high-quality, ad-free shows that offer a premium entertainment experience.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
object to the main rival option with a concrete concern

personas.name: Wren
personas.background: Wren prefers a low-cost option with enough simultaneous streams to support the flat's viewing needs while keeping the budget tight.
personas.private_goal: To keep a budget-friendly service that supports multiple simultaneous streams for the group.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept

soft_rejections.D: How many streams do we actually need at the same time? HBO Max only has three, so if we ever want to watch different stuff simultaneously, could that be a problem?

already_said: HBO Max costs more but delivers premium, ad-free shows that actually make watching worth it. We get solid quality without interruptions, which beats cheaper but annoying ads any day.

Ads are annoying but four streams for under eight bucks is unbeatable—Disney+ gets my vote!
